ui.table.desc: render array of objects as table

ui.slider.desc: range input — reactive, or callback via onInput/onChange

ui.dropdown.desc: select menu — reactive, or callback via onInput/onChange

ui.checkbox.desc: toggle — reactive, or callback via onInput/onChange

ui.textInput.desc: text field — reactive, or callback via onInput/onChange

ui.upload.desc: file picker — returns {name, data, size, type} or null

ui.drop.desc: drop zone + file picker — returns {name, data, size, type} or null

ui.confirm.sig: await ui.confirm(message, {title?, okLabel?, cancelLabel?, danger?, persistent?}?)
ui.confirm.desc: modal yes/no — returns true on ok, false on cancel/Esc. Auto-dismisses on cell re-run unless persistent

ui.prompt.sig: await ui.prompt(message, {defaultValue?, placeholder?, title?, okLabel?, cancelLabel?, persistent?}?)
ui.prompt.desc: modal text input — returns string on ok, null on cancel/Esc. Auto-dismisses on cell re-run unless persistent

ui.alert.desc: modal notice with single ok button. Auto-dismisses on cell re-run unless persistent

ui.dialog.sig: await ui.dialog({title?, width?, render(body, ctx), persistent?})
ui.dialog.desc: custom modal — render builds the body, ctx.close(value) resolves the promise. Auto-dismisses on cell re-run unless persistent

std.csv.desc: parse CSV text to array of objects

std.unique.desc: unique values with optional key fn

std.include.desc: resolve dependencies and return source for atra routines

std.hsl.desc: create color from HSL — h: 0–360, s: 0–100, l: 0–100

std.colorScale.desc: map values to colors (OKLAB interpolation or colormap fn)

print.desc: output values to cell (alias for ui.display)

worker.desc: create Web Worker from pure function — returns async callable, auto-terminates on re-run

workerPool.desc: pool of n workers (default: hardwareConcurrency) — .map(arr) for parallel batch

notebook.fs.import.desc: pick file(s) and embed in notebook filesystem

notebook.fs.export.desc: download file, folder as zip, or glob match as zip

std.zipArchive.desc: create zip — Map or [[name, Uint8Array]] → Uint8Array

// %mcp.desc: MCP access: read-only (r), or read-write (rw). enables getCellSource/getCellOutput/updateCellSource

// %private.desc: hard opt-out from MCP — cell invisible to agents, overrides manifest defaults

// %mcp describe.desc: metadata for private cells — description visible in listCells without exposing source/output

// %mcp manifest.desc: governance cell — returns {defaults, tools, fs} object. controls access for all cells

// %mcp fs.desc: allow MCP agent to access notebook.fs under prefix. :read = no writes. * = all paths

vfs.desc: virtual filesystem — pluggable backends (memory, idb, opfs, fetch, overlay, cache), mount table, glob, permissions

std.VFS.desc: alias for vfs — the VFS class for creating virtual filesystems

sr.signal.desc: reactive atom — read() tracks, write(v) or write(fn) notifies

sr.computed.desc: derived signal — recomputes lazily when deps change

sr.effect.desc: side effect — re-runs on signal change, return cleanup fn

sr.h.desc: reactive DOM — tagged template or hyperscript, signal-driven bindings

sr.each.desc: reactive list — minimal DOM updates on array changes

sr.render.desc: mount reactive content, returns dispose for cleanup

sr.batch.desc: batch signal writes — effects fire once after fn completes

sr.state.desc: cell-persistent signal — survives re-execution from upstream changes, resets on code edit
